Military Zombie Roleplay Survival & PvP Factions Servers

Welcome to Girls&Boys vs ZOMBIES, Make your way to defend deserted settlement in the area of West Black Mesa Town, only populated with military and diseases that turn people into Zombies.

A Remake From Scratch Of The Old 2012 Survival Game Made By VespasianBizan.
Remastered To Fit Today's Modern Standards, For Keeping It A Place In History And To Add New Features And Mechanics To It.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
1. Shoot Crates For Equipment.
2. VIP Servers Are Recommended, Type !Cmds To View Commands.
3. Kills Reset 30 Minutes After You Leave - Cash Is Permanent.
4. Zero Tolerance Policy For ANY Kind Of Exploiting, Malicious Or Not.
5. For a list of emotes type "/e emotes"

Join Our Communication Server! 
Thank You For All These Years Of Support.
